title: How 5 First-Round Picks SAVED The Knicks: The Mikal Bridges Story
description:
The Mikal Bridges trade shocked the NBA world when the Knicks sent FIVE first-round picks to Brooklyn in July 2024. Critics called it catastrophic. Media torched Leon Rose. And for 18 months, it looked like a franchise-destroying mistake. Then came the 2026 playoffs. Everything changed.

This is the complete story of how the most criticized trade in recent NBA history became vindicated by championship glory. We break down what the Knicks gave up, why Bridges struggled initially, how he transformed in the playoffs, and why this trade will be studied for decades as a masterclass in bold decision-making. From five picks to five games to banner number three at Madison Square Garden.
